graphFamiliesNote: The original Rome graph pool is retained; graph families prevent adjacent repeats. Wien and Sydney are excluded.

part1.title: Part 1 · Match nodes in static drawings
part1.instruction: The four highlighted nodes on the left form a path. Select the same four nodes in the drawing on the right, shown at a different aspect ratio.
part1.targetsNote: Four consecutive path vertices, identical across ARCOL and DARCOL for each graph.

part2.title: Part 2 · Remember a tree’s direction
part2.instruction: Look at the unmarked graph for six seconds, then watch the animation. A tree will be marked in red only after playback. Which direction did that tree point before the animation: left, right, up, or down? Judge the direction away from where the tree joins the rest of the graph.
